title: Arkret Governance Registry Snapshot
description: Small content-addressed manifest for exact historical apply_seal registry artifacts. Artifact bytes are independent dependency items and are never inlined in this manifest.

artifacts.description: Canonical artifact_id UTF-8 byte order. Starting with both root_schema_artifact_ids, recursively parse every local JSON Schema $ref, resolve it relative to the referring artifact, and include every-and-only reachable local schema exactly once. Missing, duplicate, surplus, non-canonical order, an escaped path, an unresolved ref, or a descriptor whose digest does not match the separately fetched canonical artifact bytes fails closed.

governance_replay_schema_manifest.description: Closed transitive schema closure required to parse accepted Event envelopes and payloads during historical apply_seal replay. It is fetched as the replay_schema_manifest registry artifact and is not inlined in GovernanceRegistrySnapshot.

canonical_bytes_b64u.description: Unpadded base64url of exact RFC 8785 JCS bytes; decoded canonical bytes MUST be at most 1 MiB.

governance_registry_artifact.description: descriptor.content_digest = SHA-256(UTF8('ak.governance-registry-artifact-v1') || 0x00 || decoded canonical_bytes_b64u). replay_schema_manifest bytes MUST validate as GovernanceReplaySchemaManifest; replay_json_schema bytes MUST parse as the named Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema. Other branches parse under their registered artifact contract.

artifacts.description: Exact closed set and order. contract-registry owns reducer profile, lattice/FSM, active Event-kind contract and dependency extractor; proof-context-registry freezes detached proof transcripts; replay_schema_manifest commits the deterministic transitive local-schema closure rooted at event-envelope and event-payload. Missing, duplicate or surplus descriptors fail closed.
